authorization: User requested the same Lean decision, implementation, validation and feedback process for PR #2698. No fleet grammar decision is inferred.

decisions.D002r1: Disabled ignores cutoff; absent differs from malformed.
decisions.D003r1: Prepare activation once, retain flag-wide invalid state and optional parsed timestamps.
decisions.D004r2: Flag-wide invalid activation fails only effective future mode, including unreachable and ordinary allocations.
decisions.D005r2: Only the surrounding-whitespace clause is adopted for cutoff and activation. Remaining syntax uses Chrono; startAt/endAt are unchanged.
decisions.D010r1: The 90-case profile uses explicit booleans. Existing omitted-doLog compatibility remains unchanged.
decisions.D011r1: Immediate exclusion applies now; future retains strictly older activation.
decisions.D016r1: Malformed enabled cutoff precedes missing flag lookup.
decisions.D017r2: Inactive policy skips the real exclusion helper; native instrumentation is not a timing claim.
